description: AI Voiceover for Existing Videos — machine-readable feature list derived from plan.md Todos.

status_rules.in_progress: Being worked on right now. Only one feature should be in_progress at a time.
status_rules.implemented: Code written, but verification NOT yet executed. This is NOT a completed state.
status_rules.verified: ALL verification[].command entries have been ACTUALLY EXECUTED and passed, with evidence recorded in agent-progress.md. Only this state counts as done.
status_rules.blocked: Cannot proceed; blocked_reason must be filled in.

hard_rule: A feature MUST NOT be set to 'verified' merely because source files exist or because the code looks correct. Verification commands must be actually run, and their output recorded in agent-progress.md with a timestamp.

verification_types.command: Automated: a shell command whose exit code 0 means pass.
verification_types.manual: Human/agent-observed check with an explicit pass condition. Requires evidence note in agent-progress.md.

产出单一完整音轨规划（TimelinePlan）

features.title: 视频处理与 ffmpeg 导出
acceptance: probe(path) 返回时长、分辨率、是否含音轨、视频编码参数
导出命令包含 -c:v copy -c:a aac
仅当容器/编码不兼容才回退 -c:v libx264，且通过回调通知上层
replace 模式丢弃原音轨；overlay 模式使用 amix + volume=original_volume（可调，不写死）
解析 ffmpeg stderr 的 time= 字段回报进度
cancel 能终止子进程并清理临时文件
ffmpeg 路径必须来自 ffmpeg_locator，不得硬编码字符串 'ffmpeg'

verification.pass_condition: all tests pass（命令构造断言 + 进度解析用例）
端到端导出用例通过（需真实 ffmpeg 与样例视频）
输出视频时长与源误差 < 0.05s（PRODUCT A1）
耗时 < 15s 且 ffprobe 确认视频流编码参数与源一致（PRODUCT A3）
ffmpeg 子进程结束，临时文件被清理，UI 恢复可用
